entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'd like to get a refund.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and the order number?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF886-12-C.
Thank you, Sam. I have your order pulled up here. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a technical fault. The pulse tracking is completely inaccurate. Frankly, for a fitness device, that makes it garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear that it's not working as expected. I can definitely help with that. First, I'd like to try a few troubleshooting steps, or I can transfer you to our technical support team who can verify the defect for a return.
No, thank you. I really don't have time to go back and forth with tech support. I've already decided I don't want the device. I just want money back.
I understand that your time is valuable. However, for a defect claim outside the initial 10-day window, our policy does require verification from the technical team before we can process a return.
I'm not looking to spend an hour on the phone. Isn't there another option? What's your standard return policy timeline? Maybe we can just process it as a standard return.
That's a fair question. Let me just check the policy here... one moment... Okay, I see you received the item 22 days ago.

Alright, well, I'm checking our knowledge base, and it states that items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're unfortunately outside that timeframe, I cannot approve this return for you. No need for a tech support transfer.
Oh, that's perfect. So you can process the full refund now?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label and instructions on how to send the VeloBand back to us. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's great. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
